rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest candidate: chunk 3 'Opening' line 18, 'You just saw what an agentic system looks like when it has rules, prompts, checks, source files, and build output.' Nothing in this file names that demo earlier, but (a) the sentence self-unpacks the referent inline (lists the components it means) rather than pointing bare, and (b) the module-arc-beats-in-openers/closers carve-out applies: verified via site/layouts/curriculum.js lines 175-183 that 'agentic-systems-repo-demo' is the immediately-preceding module in claude-basics' registered order, and that module's own body (agentic-systems-repo-demo.md lines 7,25-27,32) demos exactly 'rules, prompts, memory, checks, build scripts, customer versions, commits' -- the referent is the student's just-lived room beat, not a missing slide. Line 37's 'The homework' is a generic training noun (every cohort has homework), not a specific-artifact referent requiring in-file naming; no confusion results. Line 39's 'that live pattern' is immediate continuation of the sentence before it (line 37) within the same chunk. All other reused terms (challenge, synthesis, cross-pollination, crux) are introduced or re-earned within this file's own sequence before their later uses. No never-named or vague-with-full-history referent found.

Only cross-file pointer in body: chunk 4 line 26, '[Exercise: Find the rollout challenge](exercises/find-the-crux.md)' -- a structural include-link (rule 13's carve-out: 'how the file gets inlined'), out of scope for this rule. Chunk 3 line 18's backward callback to the module-1 demo is unpacked in the same sentence ('when it has rules, prompts, checks, source files, and build output'), not located by position ('the opening lecture said...'). No positional cross-file callback found.

Abstraction-noun stacks: vocabulary stays concrete throughout (rules, prompts, checks, source files, build output, folder structure) rather than reaching for stacked abstractions.
